rows.text: September 11, 2008
The Monetary Policy Committee of the Bank of Korea decided today to maintain the Base Rate at its current level (5.25%) for the intermeeting period.
(The following is an English translation of the Monetary Policy Committee statement.)
The Bank of Korea
Monetary Policy Decision
The Monetary Policy Committee of the Bank of Korea decided today to maintain the Base Rate at its current level (5.25%) for the intermeeting period.
Domestic economic activity has continued to slacken owing to lackluster domestic demand that the sustained buoyancy of exports has failed to offset.
The Monetary Policy Committee of the Bank of Korea decided today to maintain the Base Rate at its current level (5.25%) for the intermeeting period.
(The following is an English translation of the Monetary Policy Committee statement.)
A high degree of uncertainty still surrounds future economic developments, largely due to international financial market unrest and the US economic slowdown.
Consumer price inflation slowed slightly due to the decline in international oil prices, but it seems likely to remain at a high level for quite some time.
